svg.text: 157 nodes · 640 relationships · 48 implied labels, generated from the B2MML V0700 XML schemas published by MESA International (GitHub MESAInternational/B2MML-BatchML, tag V7.00.00). The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the type in the B2MML schema.
Resources — personnel, equipment, physical assets, material, locations and tests
Operations — process segments, definitions, schedules, performance, capability and events
Work — work definitions, schedules, performance, capability, alerts, calendars and records
Common — segment resources, parameters and record templates
composition: owner to its nested parts
reference: an ID that identifies another object
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

HAS_HIERARCHY_SCOPE: Where the EquipmentClass fits within the role-based equipment hierarchy: the Equipment its hierarchy scope identifies. Each EquipmentClass has at most one hierarchy scope. The hierarchy scope identifies where the exchanged information fits within the role-based equipment hierarchy. It defines the scope of the exchanged information, such as a site or area for which the information is relevant. The hierarchy scope identifies the associated instance in the role-based equipment hierarchy.

A composition: each WorkflowSpecificationNodeTypeProperty is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION_PROPERTY_CHILD: The workflow specification property child of the WorkflowSpecificationProperty. Each WorkflowSpecificationProperty has zero or more WorkflowSpecificationProperty. A composition: each WorkflowSpecificationProperty is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_HIERARCHY_SCOPE: Where the WorkflowSpecification fits within the role-based equipment hierarchy: the Equipment its hierarchy scope identifies. Each WorkflowSpecification has at most one hierarchy scope. The hierarchy scope identifies where the exchanged information fits within the role-based equipment hierarchy. It defines the scope of the exchanged information, such as a site or area for which the information is relevant. The hierarchy scope identifies the associated instance in the role-based equipment hierarchy.

HAS_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION_NODE: The workflow specification node of the WorkflowSpecification. Each WorkflowSpecification has one or more WorkflowSpecificationNode. A composition: each WorkflowSpecificationNode is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION_CONNECTION: The workflow specification connection of the WorkflowSpecification. Each WorkflowSpecification has zero or more WorkflowSpecificationConnection. A composition: each WorkflowSpecificationConnection is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

HAS_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION_PATTERN: The WorkflowSpecification the WorkflowSpecification refers to by its WorkflowSpecificationPatternID, the ID of the WorkflowSpecification. Each WorkflowSpecification refers to at most one WorkflowSpecification.

HAS_WORKFLOW_SPECIFICATION_PROPERTY: The workflow specification property of the WorkflowSpecification. Each WorkflowSpecification has zero or more WorkflowSpecificationProperty. A composition: each WorkflowSpecificationProperty is part of at most one owner and is deleted with it.

OperationalLocation — A logical or physical location where a material lot, material sublot, equipment, physical asset or person is located or expected to be located shall be presented as an operational location. Operational locations may be made up of other operational locations. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationalLocationType, declared in B2MML-OperationalLocation.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, spatialDefinition, spatialDefinitionFormat, spatialDefinitionSrid, spatialDefinitionSridAuthority

OperationalLocationClass — A representation of a grouping of operational locations with similar characteristics for a definite purpose such as manufacturing operations definition, scheduling, capability and performance shall be presented as an operational location class. Any operational location may be a member of zero or more operational location classes. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationalLocationClassType, declared in B2MML-OperationalLocation.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate

OperationalLocationClassProperty — An ISA-95 operational location class property. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationalLocationClassPropertyType, declared in B2MML-OperationalLocation.xsd. Properties: id, description, value, valueDataType, valueUnitOfMeasure, valueKey, propertyType

OperationalLocationInformation — Operational locations define the logical or physical places in which resources are located or are expected to be located within a plant. Operational locations may be made up of smaller operational locations. An operational location may belong to one or more operational location classes. An operational location class may be a specialization of one or more operational location classes. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationalLocationInformationType, declared in B2MML-OperationalLocation.xsd. Properties: id, description, publishedDate

OperationalLocationProperty — An ISA-95 operational location property. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationalLocationPropertyType, declared in B2MML-OperationalLocation.xsd. Properties: id, description, value, valueDataType, valueUnitOfMeasure, valueKey

OperationsDefinition — An ISA-95 operations definition. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsDefinitionType, declared in B2MML-OperationsDefinition.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, operationsType, definitionType, billOfMaterialsId, billOfResourcesId

OperationsDefinitionInformation — An ISA-95 operations definition information. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsDefinitionInformationType, declared in B2MML-OperationsDefinition.xsd. Properties: id, description, publishedDate

OperationsEvent — Large numbers of real-world events occur in any given manufacturing system. Only some real-world events are associated with manufacturing operations management activities and functions. The subset of those real-world events that require notification of process context specific information exchanges of this standard shall be defined as operations events. Operations events may be generated by any Level 4 or Level 3 function or activity. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsEventType, declared in B2MML-OperationsEvent.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, effectiveTimeStamp, recordTimeStamp, priority, operationsEventType, operationsEventLevel, operationsType, momFunction, enterpriseFunction, category, acknowledgement, source

OperationsEventClass — An operations event class is a representation of groupings of operations event definitions. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsEventClassType, declared in B2MML-OperationsEvent.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, extension

OperationsEventClassProperty — An ISA-95 operations event class property. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsEventClassPropertyType, declared in B2MML-OperationsEvent.xsd. Properties: id, description, propertyType, value, valueDataType, valueUnitOfMeasure, valueKey

OperationsEventDefinition — Definition and structure of operations event occurrences shall be shown as an operations event definition. The operations event definition of an operations event is identified by the definition ID attribute in the operations event occurrence. Those constructing or interpreting an operations event obtain and validate the structure and definition from the operations event definition. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsEventDefinitionType, declared in B2MML-OperationsEvent.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, priority, operationsEventType, operationsEventLevel, operationsType, momFunction, enterpriseFunction, category, acknowledgement, source

OperationsEventDefinitionProperty — An ISA-95 operations event definition property. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsEventDefinitionPropertyType, declared in B2MML-OperationsEvent.xsd. Properties: id, description, propertyType, value, valueDataType, valueUnitOfMeasure, valueKey

OperationsEventInformation — The operations event model represents a generic representation of event notifications using the operations event object and the constructs required to define, group and structure the operations event occurrences. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsEventInformationType, declared in B2MML-OperationsEvent.xsd. Properties: id, description, publishedDate

OperationsEventProperty — An ISA-95 operations event property. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsEventPropertyType, declared in B2MML-OperationsEvent.xsd. Properties: id, description, value, valueDataType, valueUnitOfMeasure, valueKey

OperationsSchedule — An ISA-95 operations schedule. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsScheduleType, declared in B2MML-OperationsSchedule.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedDate, startTime, endTime, operationsType, scheduleState

OperationsTestInformation — Operations test information is exchanged to communicate criteria that are to be applied to perform tests of personnel, equipment, physical assets and/or materials and to communicate the results of those tests. Exchanged in B2MML as OperationsTestInformationType, declared in B2MML-OperationsTest.xsd. Properties: id, description, publishedDate

PersonnelClass — A representation of a grouping of persons with similar characteristics for a definite purpose such as manufacturing operations definition, scheduling, capability and performance is a personnel class. Any person may be a member of zero or more personnel classes. A personnel class may be defined as a specialization of zero or more personnel class. A personnel class may be made up of zero or more personnel class(s). Exchanged in B2MML as PersonnelClassType, declared in B2MML-Personnel.xsd. Properties: id, version, description, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate

Any physical asset is a member of one physical asset class. A physical asset class may be defined as a specialization of zero or more physical asset classes. A physical asset class may be made up of zero or more physical asset classes. Exchanged in B2MML as PhysicalAssetClassType, declared in B2MML-PhysicalAsset.xsd. Properties: id, version, description, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, manufacturer

PhysicalAssetInformation — The physical asset model contains information about the physical piece of equipment, usually managed as a physical asset within the enterprise often utilizing a specific serial number. An object in the equipment model defines a role for the equipment, and object in the physical asset model defines the physical asset ID and properties of a piece of equipment. Exchanged in B2MML as PhysicalAssetInformationType, declared in B2MML-PhysicalAsset.xsd. Properties: id, description, publishedDate

ProcessSegment — A process segment lists the classes of personnel, equipment, physical assets, and material needed, and/or it may present specific resources, such as specific equipment needed for the process segment. A process segment may list the quantity of the resource needed. A process segment may be a specialization of another process segment. A process segment shall be defined as a “pattern” or an “instance”. A pattern process segment defines a ‘template’, upon which other pattern or instance process segments may be based. Unlike instance process segments, pattern process segments shall not be directly scheduled or tracked. Therefore, segment requirements, segment responses and process segment capabilities shall not reference pattern process segments. Where a process segment references a work master, the definition type (pattern or instance) of the referenced work master shall have the same value as that of the process segment. Exchanged in B2MML as ProcessSegmentType, declared in B2MML-ProcessSegment.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, operationsType, definitionType

TestResult — Operations test information is exchanged to communicate test result for evaluated test criteria and/or property measurement for performed test specifications of personnel, equipment, physical assets and/or materials. The test result details for the evaluation of test specification criteria and/or property measurement of the tested evaluated property(s) required for a testable object to match the quality or performance requirements of a test specification. A test result may contain other test results to form a hierarchy of test specifications. Exchanged in B2MML as TestResultType, declared in B2MML-OperationsTest.xsd. Properties: id, description, evaluationDate, expiration, testableObjectId, operationsTestRequirementId, evaluatedCriterionResult

TestSpecification — The test specification details the test specification criteria and the tested evaluated property(s) required for a testable object to match the quality or performance requirements of the business or particular customers. A test specification may contain other test specifications to form a hierarchy of test specifications. Exchanged in B2MML as TestSpecificationType, declared in B2MML-OperationsTest.xsd. Properties: id, description, version, publishedEndDate, effectiveStartDate, effectiveEndDate, testSampleSize, testSampleSizeDataType, testSampleSizeUnitOfMeasure, testSampleSizeKey, recurrenceQuantity, recurrenceQuantityDataType, recurrenceQuantityUnitOfMeasure, recurrenceQuantityKey, recurrenceTimeInterval, physicalSampleRequired, operationsTestRequirementId, testableObjectId
